==League tables==

===Super League===
{{further|2011 Malaysia Super League}}

A total of fourteen teams participated in the league, including twelve sides from the [[2010 Super League Malaysia|2010 season]] and two promoted teams from the [[2010 Malaysia Premier League]].

[[Johor FA]] and [[Penang FA]] were relegated at the end of the [[2010 Super League Malaysia]] after finishing the season in the bottom two places of the league table.

[[2010 Malaysia Premier League]] champions [[Felda United FC]] and runners-up [[Sabah FA]] secured direct promotion to the Super League.

[[Harimau Muda A]] secured a place in the Super League after [[PLUS FC|KL Plus]] withdrew. Harimau had won the [[2009 Premier League Malaysia]] before playing the 2010 campaign in the [[Slovak First League]]. Harimau represent the Malaysian Under 21 national football team.
{{:2011 Malaysia Super League}}
;Notes
*PLUS withdrew from Super League before the start of 2011 season

===Premier League===
{{further|2011 Malaysia Premier League}}

A total of twelve teams participated in the league, including eight sides from the 2010 Malaysia Premier League season, two newly promoted teams from [[Malaysia FAM Cup 2010|2010 Malaysia FAM Cup]] and two relegated teams from the [[2010 Super League Malaysia]] season.

[[Johor FA]] and [[Penang FA]] were relegated from [[2010 Malaysia Premier League]] after finishing the season in the bottom two places of the league table. There was a plan to merge [[Johor FA]] and [[Johor FC]] so that Johor FA can still compete at the Malaysia's top league, [[Super League Malaysia|Malaysia Super League]]. The plan was drop due to unknown reason.

[[Malaysia FAM Cup 2010|2010 Malaysia FAM Cup]] champions [[Sime Darby FC]] and runners-up [[Sinar Dimaja Mai Sarah FC]] secured direct promotion to the Malaysia Premier League.
{{:2011 Malaysia Premier League}}
===FAM League===
{{further|2011 Malaysia FAM League}}

A total of eleven teams participated in the league, including four sides from the [[Malaysia FAM Cup 2010|2010 Malaysia FAM Cup]] season, two relegated teams from the [[2010 Malaysia Premier League]] season and featuring 5 new teams which two teams that won the [[Malaysia National Region Play Off|National Region Play Off]] and three newly created teams which is [[Persatuan Bola Sepak Tentera Darat|Tentera Darat FC]], [[TUDM Hornet FC]] and [[Royal Malay Force Regiment FC|Kor RAMD FC]].

[[SDMS Kepala Batas FC]] and [[Malacca FA]] were relegated from [[2010 Malaysia Premier League]] after finishing the season in the bottom two places of the league table. [[Malaysia National Region Play Off|National Region Play Off]] champions, [[Betaria FC]] and [[Rapid KL FC]] secured direct promotion to the Malaysia Premier League.
{{:2011 Malaysia FAM League}}
